title: Weather Clothes Match
hook: Name alone does not guarantee weather protection.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: colorful 3D clothing storybook, child-friendly garments and accessories, clean single-item presentation; visual identity: Weather Clothes Match

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child matching clothes to current conditions
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Weather Clothes Match a condition-to-layer decision song: temperature, rain, wind, sun, surface and activity determine clothing; it explicitly rejects one-name assumptions like Ugg Boots always waterproof or Yellow Jacket always high-vis.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child checks conditions first, then matches breathable, insulating, waterproof, protective, or indoor footwear roles with uncertainty when product construction varies.
